description: This file declares a helper class and functions for adjusting string offsets during UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, including offset adjustments and reversions, with support for tracking adjustments.

classes.name: OffsetAdjuster
classes.description: A helper class for adjusting string offsets in response to modifications such as eliminations or insertions.

methods.name: AdjustOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts multiple offsets based on a series of string adjustments.

methods.name: AdjustOffset
methods.description: Adjusts a single offset based on string adjustments.

methods.name: UnadjustOffsets
methods.description: Reverses offset adjustments to map back to the original string.

methods.name: MergeSequentialAdjustments
methods.description: Combines two sets of adjustments into one, maintaining correct offsets relative to the original string.
